notes: Fourteen complete direction headings: 41 rows, 37 individually printed nonstop schedules, two connecting itineraries and two through-stop rows. All accepted rows have triangle and ASA number range from p4; no dated footnotes.

Weekdays are decoded for each physical leg independently. Blank daily; X6 except Saturday; X7 except Sunday. MEM–GLH 1299, MEM–MEI 1451 are X7 while their return legs are daily; MEM–GLH 1401 daily while GLH–MEM 1401 is X6.
MEM–PIB 1402 and PIB–MEM 1298 through rows are excluded; separate MEM–GLH/GLH–PIB and PIB–GLH/GLH–MEM rows represent those services without a duplicate direct flight.
MEM–PIB 1424 is 15:30–16:45, not 15:34. MEM–GTR 1247 is 16:10–17:00, not 17:05. MEI–MEM 1447 is 17:25–18:28. Enlarged scans checked.
MEI–PIB 21:05–21:35 is 1449 from ATL via MEI. It is not an extension of MEM–MEI 1453; itinerary p264 confirms the distinction.
All six endpoint airports use Central winter UTC−6. Accepted arrivals are same local date. Independent manual 24-hour transcription, fixed offsets and weekday calculation match generated movements.
Ten independently printed same-number segment transitions on 28 February have checked ground intervals; this does not establish an individual aircraft identity.

Directory pp260–261 identifies FSM Municipal, GTR Golden Triangle, GLH Municipal, MEI Key Field and PIB Pine Belt Regional. Historical site sources and approximate modern coordinates recorded separately.
Greenville Municipal naming is disambiguated by Federal Register 30 October 1969 p17511: 33°29′05″N 90°59′20″W is the present Mid Delta airport area. The old southeast municipal site is not used.

No source scan redistributed. Timetable end date and subsequent amendments unverified. Planned service only; no completed-airline or global coverage claim. Earlier objects, corrections and held conflicts unchanged.
